title: The Thane's Welcome
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Thane Hallvard wants a look at the stranger who came up the road, and sends the player to meet the village's forgemaster and its miner.

About

Given byThane Hallvard
Level20
LengthShort
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring in the steps recorded so far.

Steps

  1. Talk to Thane Hallvard to get the quest.
  2. Meet Forgemaster Dagna at -259, -1021
  3. Meet Miner Tobb at -316, -1051
  4. Return to Thane Hallvard inside Frostspire

Rewards

Reward
Gold448
Character XP14,000
Quest points1

What Thane Hallvard says

You: The thane sent me to meet you.

Forgemaster Dagna: Did he? He does that with anyone he likes the look of. I'm Dagna. Everything made of iron in this village came off my anvils.

Forgemaster Dagna: Finish your rounds first. After that I may have work for you.

You: The thane sent me around to meet everyone.

Miner Tobb: Tobb. I look after Silverdelve, the village mine, through that door behind me. Silver, mostly, and it pays for half of Frostspire.

Miner Tobb: It's been a bad month down there. I'll tell you about it another time. Go and tell the thane you found me.

Thane Hallvard: Well? Dagna will have talked your ear off about her forge, and Tobb will have said as little as he could.

Thane Hallvard: They're good folk, both of them. Dagna asked me this morning whether I knew anyone with strong arms. Go and see her.

Handing it in

"They're good folk, both of them. Dagna asked me this morning whether I knew anyone with strong arms. Go and see her."
